token_set.name: Hometown History: Chicago Blackhawks
token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Chicago Blackhawks, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Blackhawks during the 2023-24 season.  These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
Debut to Remember: On October 4, 1990, Chris Chelios made his Blackhawks debut in Chicago Stadium versus the New York Rangers one to remember. In the opening minute of the third period and with two assists in the game already, No. 7 took a pass from Steve Larmer at the point and fired a slap shot past John Vanbiesbrouck to extend the Blackhawks lead to 4-1. Chicago went on to win the game 4-3, with Chelios tallying three points and his first goal with the Blackhawks.
